title: Rectangle area
statement: Define a class Rectangle with a width, a height and a method area(). Read the width and the height, create a Rectangle and print its area.

title: Bank account
statement: Define a class Account with a balance, a deposit method and a withdraw method that ignores a withdrawal larger than the balance. The first line is the starting balance, the second is the number of operations, then each operation is D amount or W amount. Print the final balance.
